world_read.summary: A surreal, finely rendered coastal scene places a floating black armored vessel bound in ivory ribs and articulated bones near the center-right. A tall broken turquoise gateway rises at left; a separate suspended arrangement of fruit, flowers, drapery, classical figures and a peacock occupies the upper right. A pale moon and open blue sky separate the three principal forms. The planned machine-and-bone anchor is clearly visible, although the overall plate is illustrative rather than minimal and expressionist.
